### Frequently asked questions

What is Curve Dental?![](https://www.curvedental.com/hubfs/raw_assets/public/CurveDental/images/icons/open.svg)![](https://www.curvedental.com/hubfs/raw_assets/public/CurveDental/images/icons/close.svg)

Curve Dental is a cloud-based practice management platform for dental offices — scheduling, imaging, billing, and patient communication in one system.

[See how Curve works →](https://www.curvedental.com/independent-practice/curve-overview)

How much does it cost?![](https://www.curvedental.com/hubfs/raw_assets/public/CurveDental/images/icons/open.svg)![](https://www.curvedental.com/hubfs/raw_assets/public/CurveDental/images/icons/close.svg)

Pricing depends on practice size and the features you need. Request a quote and our team will walk you through the plan that fits your practice.

Is it cloud-based, and does it work on Mac?![](https://www.curvedental.com/hubfs/raw_assets/public/CurveDental/images/icons/open.svg)![](https://www.curvedental.com/hubfs/raw_assets/public/CurveDental/images/icons/close.svg)

Yes — Curve runs entirely in the cloud through your browser, so it works on Mac, PC, and Chromebooks with no local server to maintain.

What systems can you convert from?![](https://www.curvedental.com/hubfs/raw_assets/public/CurveDental/images/icons/open.svg)![](https://www.curvedental.com/hubfs/raw_assets/public/CurveDental/images/icons/close.svg)

Curve's implementation team handles data conversion from most major practice management systems as part of onboarding.

[See our implementation process →](https://www.curvedental.com/implementation)

Is it HIPAA compliant?![](https://www.curvedental.com/hubfs/raw_assets/public/CurveDental/images/icons/open.svg)![](https://www.curvedental.com/hubfs/raw_assets/public/CurveDental/images/icons/close.svg)

Yes — Curve is built with HIPAA-compliant infrastructure and security controls to help protect patient data.

What does the AI actually do?![](https://www.curvedental.com/hubfs/raw_assets/public/CurveDental/images/icons/open.svg)![](https://www.curvedental.com/hubfs/raw_assets/public/CurveDental/images/icons/close.svg)

Curve's AI features help with tasks like answering patient questions, scheduling, and insurance verification, cutting down manual front-desk work.

[Explore Curve AI →](https://www.curvedental.com/ai)

Is support U.S.-based?![](https://www.curvedental.com/hubfs/raw_assets/public/CurveDental/images/icons/open.svg)![](https://www.curvedental.com/hubfs/raw_assets/public/CurveDental/images/icons/close.svg)

Yes — Curve's support team is based in the U.S. and is available by phone, chat, and email.
